name: vision_supports_media_in_tool_results
notes: Provider/model gate for media in tool results (src/tools/vision.c vs LIVE tools/vision_tools.py). Inputs restricted to clean lowercase providers because of two KNOWN, documented divergences: (1) LIVE strip()+lower()s the provider before the set checks; C strcmp's it raw — mixed-case/padded providers diverge. (2) LIVE falls back to ProviderProfile.supports_vision for unknown providers (e.g. xiaomi may be True); C has no profile lookup and always returns false. Also LIVE tests 'gemini-3' as a plain substring while C requires 'gemini-3.'/'gemini-3-'/'==gemini-3'/pro-3/flash-3 — models like 'gemini-30' would diverge and are avoided.
